property_summary: For any accounts and ids arrays of equal length, balanceOfBatch must return an array where every index i (0 <= i < accounts.length) holds the balance of accounts[i] with respect to ids[i], but the buggy mutation leaves zeros at every second index.
change_summary: Change the balanceOfBatch loop increment from ++i to i += 2 so every other account is skipped, producing half the outputs.
